test_dtype_to_arrow_c_fmt_numpy_dtypes: test dtype_to_arrow_c_fmt with numpy dtypes like int64, float64, bool and returns their Arrow C format strings
test_dtype_to_arrow_c_fmt_pandas_dtypes: test dtype_to_arrow_c_fmt with pandas dtypes like datetime64, categorical and string returning their Arrow C format strings
test_dtype_to_arrow_c_fmt_arrow_dtypes: test dtype_to_arrow_c_fmt with pyarrow-backed ArrowDtype including timestamp, duration, decimal and time types
test_dtype_to_arrow_c_fmt_null_binary: test dtype_to_arrow_c_fmt with pyarrow null and binary types returning n and z format strings
test_dtype_to_arrow_c_fmt_tz_aware_times: test dtype_to_arrow_c_fmt with pyarrow timestamp including timezone returning tsn:UTC format string
